abstract: Carboplatin was evaluated in a phase II study involving 109 patients with genitourinary cancer. A total of 21 cases of advanced testicular tumor, 38 of transitional cell carcinoma (TCC) of the urinary tract and 25 of prostatic cancer were evaluable for response. The response rate in testicular tumors was 48%, with 70% in seminomas and 27% in nonseminomas. Three responses were observed in patients previously treated with cisplatin. In TCC, the response rate was 18%. No response was observed in prostatic cancer. Carboplatin was well tolerated with no significant renal impairment and ototoxicity detected. Nausea and vomiting were experienced by 50% of patients but the severity was low. Severe myelosuppression, thrombocytopenia and leukopenia were observed. In conclusion, carboplatin has demonstrated activity in both testicular tumors and TCC of the urinary tract and is worthy of further study, especially in combination with other active drugs.
abstract_ja: 109例の泌尿生殖器がん患者を対象としたカルボプラチンの第II相試験を行った。奏効評価可能であったのは、進行精巣腫瘍21例、尿路移行上皮癌（TCC）38例、前立腺がん25例であった。精巣腫瘍の奏効率は48%で、セミノーマでは70%、非セミノーマでは27%であった。シスプラチン治療歴のある患者では3例に奏効がみられた。TCCの奏効率は18%であった。前立腺がんでは奏効はみられなかった。カルボプラチンは腎機能障害や聴器毒性を認めず、よく忍容された。悪心・嘔吐は50%の患者に認められたが重症度は低かった。重度の骨髄抑制、血小板減少症、白血球減少症が観察された。結論として、カルボプラチンは精巣腫瘍および尿路TCCに対して活性を示し、特に他の有効薬との併用について今後の検討に値する。
